276730850.description:
W.A. Sheaffer Pen Co.
Gold Plated and Resin Fountain Pen
Mid-Century Modern, Circa 1940s-1950s
This vintage W.A. Sheaffer fountain pen features a classic burgundy resin body paired with a gold-plated metal cap decorated with a wavy incised line pattern. The pen is equipped with the distinctive 14k gold "Triumph" conical wraparound nib, a hallmark of Sheaffer's mid-century premium writing instruments. The barrel is clearly stamped with the manufacturer's hallmark and location of Fort Madison, Iowa, reflecting the craftsmanship of the American golden age of fountain pens.
14k gold conical Triumph-style nib, stamped "SHEAFFER'S 14K MADE IN U.S.A."
Gold-plated cap with polished finish and horizontal wavy line engraving
Burgundy resin barrel and grip section with stamped manufacturer markings
Provided Dimensions: 3" L x 1" W x 5" H
Condition:
The pen has not been tested for functionality. Visually, the piece is in good vintage condition with age-appropriate surface wear. The gold-plated cap shows minor micro-scratching but no major dents or visible brassing. The 14k gold nib appears straight and intact. The burgundy barrel retains a good luster with readable factory imprints. Internal filling mechanism is present but its operational status is unknown.

This lot includes four petrified wood pieces weighing approximately 1 pound 6.4 ounces. Each piece measures between 3.25 and 5 inches. Under UV light, the pieces exhibit fluorescence, highlighting their mineralized structure. All pieces are in natural condition with typical surface wear. Suitable for display, collecting, or educational use.
